failures.description: 5Ni1Ru/CeO2 (Lucentini): no RPLUG run above RGibbs equilibrium (same model, same feed), 30 runs
failures.cause: runs above the PENG-ROB RGibbs equilibrium by more than 1e-4: ['cs_T_luc5_T600_P20_W100', 'cs_W_luc5_T600_P20_W200', 'cs_W_luc5_T600_P20_W500', 'cv_luc5_05_T550_P20_W1000', 'cv_luc5_06_T600_P40_W1000']. The LHHW reverse term uses the ideal-gas equilibrium constant of the kinetics spec (ln K fit) on a molarity basis (concentrations from PENG-ROB molar volumes in the molarity case), not fugacities, so the kinetic model equilibrates to a slightly different state than RGibbs (PENG-ROB fugacity based). The excess is largest at 40 bar. Not tuned; kept as a failure of this strict check. The Python PFR at the same conditions agrees within the conversion tolerance (item cat_<catalyst>_study_vs_python / cat_cv_*_vs_spec).
